label: AI Engineer
headline: AI Software Engineer | Agentic AI and Intelligent Automation
emphasis: Python · AI Agents · API Integration · Workflow Automation · Reliable AI Systems
summary: AI Software Engineer specialising in agentic systems, intelligent automation and API-integrated applications. Combine Python and JavaScript/TypeScript engineering with multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, document processing, structured outputs and human-in-the-loop workflows to connect AI capabilities with practical business processes.

Experience includes AI model training and evaluation, independent software delivery and business technology consulting. Design the services surrounding AI: APIs, webhooks, persistent state, authentication, asynchronous processing, evaluation and observability. Focus on dependable execution through exception handling, retries, bounded permissions and human review, while translating operational requirements into technical solutions and explaining limitations clearly.
